activity_error_not_found: Couldn't find this repository or package
activity_error_other: Unreachable for now; showing the last data
activity_error_rate_limited: GitHub rate limit hit: add a GitHub token in Settings
activity_job_description: Looks up the last update, versions and more for GitHub repositories and npm packages. New bookmarks are checked right away and the cron checks 3 a minute, each about weekly; this checks them all now. It pauses itself on GitHub's rate limit: resume once the quota is back.
activity_mode_missing: Only those due (never checked or over 7 days)
activity_not_checked: Not checked yet; it will be checked soon
ai_base_url_custom_hint: Up to the version, usually ending in /v1, without /chat/completions. If unsure, enter just the domain and click "Detect & fetch models" to work out whether /v1 is needed.
ai_base_url_official_hint: Uses the provider's official address. To use another address, choose "Custom".
ai_cross_language_hint: Smart search works across languages: a Chinese query can find English bookmarks and vice versa (depending on how multilingual your embedding model is). In chat, AI replies in the language you ask in.
ai_description: The chat model organizes, summarizes and answers questions; the embedding model powers smart search and duplicate detection. They can use different providers.
ai_embedding_change_hint: After changing the embedding model, rebuild the index under "Rebuild vector index" below; old vectors can't be compared with the new model.
ai_embedding_empty: Leave empty to disable vector features
ai_key_not_carried: The provider or address changed, so the saved key isn't reused. Please enter it again.
ai_key_saved: Saved {masked}; leave empty to keep it
ai_language_description: The language AI uses for notes, summaries, organize suggestions and chat replies. New categories and tags use it too; existing categories are reused first.
ai_model_hint: Pick from the fetched list or type a model name.
ai_model_none: No matching model; you can type one
ai_need_key: Enter the API key first, then fetch models
ai_request_preview: With these settings, requests go to:
api_backup_bad_format: The backup has an unexpected format
api_backup_corrupt: The backup is corrupt and can't be read
api_bad_retention: Days to keep must be a whole number from 0 (forever) to {max}
api_category_into_itself: A category can't move into its own sub-category
api_chat_incomplete: Fill in the provider, base URL, key and model
api_chat_unavailable: The chat model is unavailable; check the settings
api_embedding_incomplete: The embedding model settings are incomplete
api_embedding_unavailable: The embedding model is unavailable; check the settings
api_github_token_rejected: GitHub didn't accept this token: check that it's correct and not expired
api_import_parse_failed: Couldn't parse the content; please check the format
api_job_needs_chat: No chat model is configured yet; set one up above first
api_job_needs_embedding: No embedding model is configured yet; set one up above first
api_job_rate_limited: Paused: GitHub rate limit hit. Add a GitHub token under Access & sharing, or resume once the quota is back
api_job_running: The job is running; pause it before starting over
api_models_not_found: No model list endpoint found. Tried: {tried}
api_models_unauthorized: {url} returned {status}: the API key is invalid or disabled, or can't list models
api_need_chat: No chat model is configured yet; set one up in Settings first
api_need_embedding: No embedding model is configured yet; set one up in Settings first
api_restore_mode: mode must be merge or replace
api_share_invalid: type (item / category / tag / collection) and value (ids for a collection) are required
api_translate_empty: This bookmark has no note or summary to translate
api_webhook_invalid: Enter an http(s) URL and pick at least one event
audit_description: Every change, export, sign-in and scheduled job is recorded here.
audit_empty_hint: Every action from now on will show up here.
audit_sum_browser_render_on: Turned on Browser Rendering ({plan}, limit {minutes} min)
audit_sum_daily_backup: Daily backup: {count} bookmarks written to {name}, {removed} old backups removed
audit_sum_sign_in_denied: Sign-in denied: email not on the allowlist ({provider})
backup_description: Backed up to R2 daily and kept for 30 days. The current data is backed up again before every restore.
backup_none: No backups yet. Click "Back up now" to create the first one.
backup_not_configured: R2 backup storage isn't configured. Bind BACKUPS in wrangler.jsonc to use it.
batch_hint: Each URL is analyzed by AI; accept, edit or discard the results one by one, then save them together.
batch_leave_message: {count} accepted bookmarks haven't been saved and will be lost.
batch_status_failed: Couldn't analyze; fill it in by hand
batch_summary_title: These {count} bookmarks will be added. Remove any you don't want.
bookmarklet_description: Drag this button to your bookmarks bar, then click it on any page to save it.
bookmarklet_hint: If your browser won't let you drag it, copy the code, create a new bookmark and paste the code as its URL.
browser_render_description: Opens pages in a real browser with Cloudflare Browser Rendering and saves the text as Markdown, keeping headings, lists, code and images; pages built by JavaScript work too. Browser time is metered: once the limit below is reached, PickIt falls back to plain capture.
browser_render_enabled: Capture page text with a browser
browser_render_load_failed: Couldn't load the Browser Rendering settings
browser_render_plan_free_hint: 10 minutes of browser time a day, at most 1 request every 10 seconds. The limit can't exceed 10 minutes; the background backfill renders 1 page a minute.
browser_render_plan_paid_hint: 10 hours a month included, then $0.09 an hour. The default limit of 540 minutes leaves headroom so nothing extra is billed; raising it is billed by usage.
browser_render_unavailable: To turn this on, add the Browser binding to wrangler.jsonc and deploy again:
categories_empty_hint: Categories you give bookmarks show up here.
category_delete_message_parent: Its bookmarks and sub-categories move up to “{parent}”. No bookmarks are deleted.
category_delete_message_top: Its bookmarks become uncategorized and sub-categories move to the top level. No bookmarks are deleted.
category_drop_top: Drop here to move to the top level
category_merge_confirm_message: {count} bookmarks and all sub-categories move into “{to}”; the old category goes away.
category_merge_hint: Pick the category to fold it into. Its bookmarks and sub-categories go along.
category_move_hint: Pick a new parent. Sub-categories move along.
category_name_exists: A category with this name already exists at this level. Use “Merge into” to combine them.
chat_example: e.g. "A flowchart library for a Vue 3 project with draggable nodes"
chat_intro: Tell me what you're looking for and I'll pick from your bookmarks.
chat_placeholder: Ask something, e.g. "a library for flowcharts"…
collection_order_hint: Drag the handles to reorder the bookmarks in this collection; visitors see the new order
content_empty: This page has no readable text
content_failed: Couldn't capture it: the page may need a login or be down
cron_quiet_hint: Per-minute tasks are logged only when they did something or failed
cron_task_activity_hint: GitHub / npm projects: new ones first, each about weekly
cron_task_audit_prune_hint: Deletes audit entries past the retention period
cron_task_backup_hint: Backs up all bookmarks to R2, kept 30 days (needs R2)
cron_task_content_hint: Saves page text for older bookmarks, a few at a time (needs R2)
cron_task_jobs_hint: Keeps re-embedding, AI organizing, summaries and activity checks going after the page is closed
cron_task_link_check_hint: Checks links not checked for 7 days and looks up archives for dead ones
cron_task_previews_hint: Fetches preview images for older bookmarks, a few at a time
cron_task_vectors_hint: Adds the compact version used for fast search to older vectors
cron_tick_never: Not fired yet; runs once deployed
delete_to_trash_hint: Deleted items go to the trash and can be restored anytime.
detail_summary_empty: No summary yet. Click Summarize to create one.
dup_message: “{name}” is already saved. Save another copy?
dup_similar: This looks a lot like something you've already saved:
dups_description: Finds identical URLs first, then uses AI to find similar content.
emails_description: Only Google / GitHub accounts with these emails can sign in. Locked ones come from the ALLOWED_EMAILS secret and can't be removed here.
emails_owner: From the deployment secret, can't be removed
emails_remove_message: This email loses access immediately, including existing sessions.
error_generic: Something went wrong, please try again
error_request_later: Request failed, please try again later
form_category_new: Type to create a new category
form_category_placeholder: Pick or type a category; two levels like "Frontend/React" work
form_note_placeholder: Describe it so it's easy to find later (multi-line and Markdown supported)
form_url_placeholder: Paste a URL; AI can fill in the rest
github_token_description: Used to check the activity of GitHub repositories. Without one, GitHub allows 60 requests an hour shared with other sites, so checks get rate-limited; with one, 5,000 an hour.
github_token_from_secret: Not set here; using the GITHUB_TOKEN secret
github_token_hint: Under Repository access pick “Public repositories (read-only)”; no permissions needed. PickIt verifies it with GitHub before saving.
github_token_invalid_hint: GitHub rejected this token: it may be revoked or expired. Replace it.
github_token_unreachable: Couldn't reach GitHub; check again later
import_description: Supports Markdown tables, browser bookmark HTML and PickIt's own JSON export.
import_paste_placeholder: Paste a Markdown table / exported bookmarks HTML / PickIt JSON
import_preview_summary: Found {parsed}: {inserted} to add, {skipped} duplicates to skip
items_empty_filtered_hint: Try other keywords or clear the filters.
items_empty_hint: Click "Add" at the top right, or paste a batch of URLs.
job_background: If you leave this page, the job keeps going in the background every minute.
login_error_generic: Sign-in failed, please try again later
login_error_no_email: Couldn't get an email from the provider. Make sure the account has a verified email.
login_error_not_allowed: This account doesn't have access. Sign in with an account whose email is on the allowlist.
login_no_providers: No sign-in method is configured. Set the Google or GitHub OAuth secrets on the server.
manual_sort_hint: Drag a card to reorder it within its category (long-press on phones)
manual_sort_search_hint: Clear the search to drag bookmarks into order
mcp_description: Let AI assistants such as Claude search, read and add your bookmarks. It uses the API token above; calls are recorded in the audit log.
mcp_tools: Tools: search, get, list by category or tag, list categories, list tags, add a bookmark.
organize_hint: Tick the suggestions to apply; items without changes are skipped.
organize_job_description: Let AI recategorize and retag bookmarks, reusing existing categories where it can.
organize_limit: Up to {max} items at a time; showing the first {max}.
organize_mode_missing: Only items missing a category or tags
organize_nothing: AI suggests no changes for these bookmarks.
palette_hint_keys: Enter to open · Esc to close
public_load_failed: Failed to load. Please try again later.
public_not_found: This share link doesn't exist or has expired.
public_password_hint: The owner protected this link with a password
reembed_description: Builds the vector index for your bookmarks. After changing the embedding model, old vectors can't be compared with the new model, so rebuild them.
reembed_mode_missing: Only missing or from another model
restore_merge_hint: Adds only bookmarks you don't have (by URL); existing ones are untouched.
restore_preview: {total} in the backup; {inserted} will be restored
restore_preview_trashed: {trashed} current bookmarks will move to the trash
restore_replace_hint: Moves all current bookmarks to the trash (recoverable), then restores everything in the backup.
restore_safety: The current data is backed up first, so a restore can be undone.
retention_confirm_message: Entries older than {days} days are deleted right away and can't be recovered.
search_placeholder: Search bookmarks, or describe what you're looking for…
settings_tab_access_description: Who can sign in, the API token and MCP, the GitHub token, and webhooks
settings_tab_ai_description: For auto-organizing, smart search and Q&A
settings_tab_cron_description: How the background tasks are doing
settings_tab_data_description: Import and export, backups and restore, and the save bookmarklet
settings_tab_organize_description: Batch-organize categories and tags with AI; find and merge duplicates
share_collection_hint: Bundle the {count} selected bookmarks into one public link.
share_dialog_hint: Visitors see a live list that follows your bookmarks, with an RSS feed.
share_password_keep: Leave empty to keep the current password
share_stats_repeat_hint: Repeat views by the same visitor within 30 minutes count once
share_title_placeholder: Leave empty to use the selected name
shares_none_hint: Share a whole category or tag, or pick bookmarks to share together
shares_revoke_message: The public link will stop working immediately. Sharing again creates a new link.
summarize_job_description: Generates AI summaries for bookmarks in the background. It keeps going after you close the page and can be paused anytime.
tag_delete_message: The tag is removed from every bookmark; the bookmarks themselves stay.
tag_share_hint: Share the bookmarks with this tag publicly
tags_add_hint: Add these tags to the {count} selected items; existing tags aren't duplicated.
tags_empty_hint: Tag your bookmarks to manage the tags here.
tags_field_new: Press Enter to create a new tag
tags_field_placeholder: Type and press Enter, or pick a suggestion
tags_remove_hint: Remove these tags from the {count} selected items.
token_description: Use this token for scripts, third-party tools or AI assistants (MCP).
token_reset_message: The old token stops working immediately; update any scripts or tools that use it.
token_shown_once: The full token is shown only once, so copy it now.
trash_empty_hint: Deleted bookmarks land here first and can be restored.
webhook_dialog_hint: Pick the events to send to this URL
webhook_secret_hint: The secret is shown only this once. Store it on the receiving side to verify signatures.
webhooks_description: When an event happens, PickIt POSTs JSON to these URLs. The X-PickIt-Signature header is an HMAC-SHA256 of the body with the webhook’s secret, so you can verify the sender.
